segments.text: Its trilinear coordinates are cosine A, to cosine B, to cosine C, and its barycentric coordinates are sine two A, to sine two B, to sine two C. On the central lines layer, X three anchors the Euler line with X two, X four, and X five, the Brocard axis with X six, X fifteen, and X sixteen, and the O I line with X one and X forty.

segments.text: X three is the isogonal conjugate and complement of the Orthocenter X four, and the anticomplement of the Nine-Point Center X five. Notice across the four reference triangles how X three lies inside an acute triangle, lands on the hypotenuse midpoint of the three-four-five right triangle, and moves outside the obtuse Kimberling triangle.
